title: THE LAST BELL - Part 1: The Lockdown
notes: Qwen3-TTS. 'outside' is HER voice (voice_alias) heard through the door (fx door) - the entity copies it. Principal through the intercom (fx intercom).

narrator.design: Young woman narrator, early 20s, warm and intimate, quick natural storytelling pace, a soft smile in her voice that turns tense when things go wrong.
narrator.ref_text: I still remember that afternoon. The sun was low, the hallway was empty, and for once I wasn't nervous at all.

her.design: Teenage girl, 16, soft warm voice, a little shy and playful, gentle; when scared she whispers and her voice shakes.
her.ref_text: Okay, your handwriting is honestly the worst I've ever seen. No, I'm kidding. Kind of. Hand me the glue?

intercom.design: Middle-aged man, school principal, firm calm authoritative voice, speaking slowly and clearly into a microphone.
intercom.ref_text: Good afternoon, students. This is your principal speaking. Please listen carefully to the following announcement.

lines.text: You finally get to spend time alone with your crush after school.
Then someone using her voice starts begging you to open the classroom door.
You've had a crush on her for months. Today, you finally get time alone together.
You stay after school to finish a project.
She's laughing at your terrible handwriting.
For once, talking to her doesn't feel awkward.
Then suddenly... the emergency alarm starts screaming.
The classroom lights turn red.
"Attention. This is an emergency lockdown. An unidentified individual has entered the school."
"Lock your doors. Cover your windows. Do not respond to anyone calling your name."
You look at your crush. She's no longer smiling.
You both move away from the windows. The hallway goes completely silent.
Then... three knocks.
"Hey... can you let me in?"
She's sitting right beside you. She slowly shakes her head.
"Don't open it."
The knocking comes again. This time, it sounds exactly like her.
"Please. It's getting closer. Why are you leaving me out here?"
Your crush grabs your arm. Her hands are shaking.
"That's not me."
Then the voice says something that makes your blood run cold.
"Come on... you know I like you."
You turn toward your crush. She looks completely confused.
Your phone vibrates. A photo, from an unknown number.
It's the two of you, in this classroom... taken from behind you.
You turn around. There's nobody there.
Another message: She hasn't told you what happened last time.
Your crush starts crying. She looks right at you.
"Please... don't let it remember me."
The door handle begins to turn.
She grabs your hand and whispers...
"Whatever you do, don't let it touch your shadow."
